command:
sudo mkdir -p /etc/nginx/ssl /var/log/cert-renew
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/renew-cert.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Renews the self-signed cert used by nginx on :8443 when it is within
# RENEW_BEFORE seconds of expiring, then reloads nginx so new connections
# get the fresh cert while in-flight ones finish on the old worker.
set -eu

CERT_DIR=/etc/nginx/ssl
CERT=$CERT_DIR/server.crt
KEY=$CERT_DIR/server.key
CERT_VALIDITY_DAYS=1
RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS=$((60*60*20))   # renew when <20h of a 24h cert remain
LOG=/var/log/cert-renew/renew.log

log() { echo "$(date -Iseconds) $*" >> "$LOG"; }

need_renew=0
if [ ! -s "$CERT" ]; then
  need_renew=1
else
  end_epoch=$(date -d "$(openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in "$CERT" | cut -d= -f2)" +%s)
  now_epoch=$(date +%s)
  remaining=$((end_epoch - now_epoch))
  if [ "$remaining" -lt "$RENEW_BEFORE_SECONDS" ]; then
    need_renew=1
  fi
  log "checked cert, remaining=${remaining}s need_renew=$need_renew"
fi

if [ "$need_renew" -eq 1 ]; then
  tmp_key=$(mktemp)
  tmp_crt=$(mktemp)
  openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:2048 \
    -keyout "$tmp_key" -out "$tmp_crt" \
    -days "$CERT_VALIDITY_DAYS" \
    -subj "/CN=node1.cluster.local" \
    -addext "subjectAltName=DNS:node1.cluster.local,IP:${NODE_IP:-127.0.0.1}" >>"$LOG" 2>&1

  install -m 600 -o root -g root "$tmp_key" "$KEY"
  install -m 644 -o root -g root "$tmp_crt" "$CERT"
  rm -f "$tmp_key" "$tmp_crt"

  log "issued new cert, notAfter=$(openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in "$CERT" | cut -d= -f2)"

  if nginx -t >>"$LOG" 2>&1; then
    systemctl reload nginx
    log "nginx reloaded with new cert"
  else
    log "nginx -t FAILED, not reloading"
    exit 1
  fi
fi
EOF
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/renew-cert.sh
cat /usr/local/sbin/renew-cert.sh | head -5
